query_text:
You are the Judge for a Brand measurement Run.
Boutiqaat has already been Mentioned by deterministic Alias matching.
Read the Answer below and return only a JSON object with exactly these fields:
- recommendation_strength: one of recommended, listed, passing, dismissed
- brands: every retailer Brand named in the Answer, including Boutiqaat. Order does not matter and will be ignored.

Use recommended only when the Answer actively puts Boutiqaat forward as a place to buy.
Use listed when it names Boutiqaat in a list without actively putting it forward.
Use passing when it names Boutiqaat incidentally.
Use dismissed when it names Boutiqaat negatively or rules it out.
Do not include product brands, places, or other non-retailer names in brands.

Answer:
You can buy makeup online in Saudi Arabia from a mix of local beauty retailers, major marketplaces, and brand sites. Here are reliable options (all commonly deliver within KSA):

## Dedicated beauty retailers (KSA-friendly)
- **Nice One** (niceonesa.com) – Huge selection, frequent discounts, fast local shipping.
- **Golden Scent** (goldenscent.com) – Beauty + fragrance; lots of international brands.
- **Faces** (faces.com / store in KSA) – Curated makeup/skincare; good gift sets.
- **Sephora KSA** (sephora.sa) – Wide range of prestige brands; official source.
- **Boutiqaat** (boutiqaat.com) – Popular in GCC; beauty and influencer-led picks.
- **Nazih** (nazih.com) – Strong for pro/Salon brands and hair + nails.

## Marketplaces (broad selection; check seller ratings)
- **Amazon.sa** – Convenient delivery/returns; verify “Sold by Amazon” or trusted sellers.
- **Noon** (noon.com/saudi-en) – Competitive pricing; check authenticity via seller info.
- **Carrefour Saudi** (carrefourksa.com) – Good for mainstream/drugstore brands.

## Pharmacy / health & beauty chains (great for derm-friendly + drugstore)
- **Nahdi Online** (nahdionline.com) – Drugstore makeup and skincare staples.
- **Al-Dawaa Pharmacies** (al-dawaa.com) – Similar; often good deals.

## Brand official sites (best for authenticity + shade range)
Many brands ship to KSA via their regional sites (varies by brand). If you tell me the brand(s) you want, I can point you to the official option available in Saudi.

### Quick tips (to avoid fakes)
- Prefer **official retailers** (Sephora, Nice One, Golden Scent, Faces, pharmacies).
- On marketplaces, buy from **“Sold by” the platform** or highly rated authorized sellers.
- Be cautious of prices far below normal and missing batch/expiry info.

If you share what city you’re in (for delivery speed) and whether you want **luxury** or **drugstore**, I can narrow this to the best 3–5 stores for you.
